subject: Prospect security playbook initiation — air-gapped layout request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-29T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Prospect security playbook initiation — air-gapped layout request

Anna — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and action items from our discovery so we have a single source of truth:  

Summary of needs
- Private deployment required for EU & US customers; HIPAA will apply to several product flows.
- Primary ask: confirm SOC 2 timeline and any current attestations.
- Secondary ask: evaluate an air-gapped install option for on-prem POC; we need a basic network diagram to assess transfer/validation steps.

Immediate asks for CardioNova
1) Please confirm current SOC 2 status (type, in-progress vs. completed) and expected attestation date.
2) Share any high-level network sketch that shows where Redwood would sit in your environment (VPC peering, NAT/egress controls, proxy boundaries). A simple PNG/PDF is perfect — we'll treat it as preliminary.
3) We're sending a short vendor security questionnaire (attached draft) — please complete or tell us how you'd prefer to ingest it (Doc link, spreadsheet, or security portal).

Redwood next steps
- Monica (cc'd) will coordinate a technical deep-dive (30–45m) with your infra/security leads to walk the diagram and KMS/integration points.
- We'll supply a playbook PDF with examples for air-gapped deployments and a checklist of evidence we typically need (SOC 2 reports, dataflow diagrams, KMS attestation, egress policies).

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire_draft.pdf

Target dates
- Please share the sketch + questionnaire answers by EOD next Wed (2028-02-05) if possible — earlier helps us size the POC and identify any blockers.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a follow-up if that's easiest.

—
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Anna Somerville <anna.somerville@cardionova.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: CardioNova Security <security@cardionova.com>
Date: 2028-01-29T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Prospect security playbook initiation — air-gapped layout request

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers inline and a couple questions from our infra team:  

Answers
- SOC 2: Type II in progress; control testing started Dec 2027. We expect final attestation Q3 2028. We have a Type I from 2026 (available on request).
- GDPR/HIPAA: GDPR applies for EU customers; HIPAA applies to US PHI flows. We are certified for HITRUST assessments internally but not certified yet.

Infra questions (we'll need your confirmation)
- KMS: We use Azure Key Vault in our production accounts. For on-prem/airgapped POC we expect to manage keys locally; is Redwood able to support KMS-plugin or customer-managed key stores for private deployments?
- Outbound connectivity: For the fully air-gapped option we will not allow outbound egress from the inference hosts. For a VPC-based private deployment we can allow controlled egress to specific patch/update endpoints via a bastion.

Attached is a very rough current_network_sketch.png — it's hand-drawn, so apologies for the quality.

We'll review the questionnaire and aim to return it with answers next week. Also, could you share the playbook you mentioned so our security reviewers can scan it before the deep-dive?

Best,
Anna Somerville
Head of Infrastructure, CardioNova
anna.somerville@cardionova.com | +1 617-555-7812

Anna — great notes, and thanks for the sketch. A few clarifications and proposed next steps from the Redwood security/engineering side:  

Clarifications
- KMS support: Yes — for our Private offering we support customer-managed key stores. We have documentation for Azure Key Vault and HSM/KMS integrations for on-prem environments. For air-gapped installs we can integrate with an on-prem KMS as long as there is a validated local key provisioning workflow (we'll pair on the validation steps during the tech deep-dive).
- Outbound: For fully air-gapped installs we operate in an offline mode. Images are delivered via signed artifacts and an image-validation process. Our engineers will provide the transfer checklist (hashes, signatures, validation scripts). For VPC private installs we support strict egress whitelisting and can route updates through a customer-controlled bastion.

Suggested next steps
1) Tech deep-dive: 45m with your infra + security leads. Proposed slots: Tue 2028-02-06 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 2028-02-07 09:00–09:45 PT — which works for you?
2) We'll upload our playbook and a filled vendor questionnaire example to the shared Drive link (see thread-level related_links).
3) Please indicate if your procurement requires an NDA or data processing agreement before we exchange attestation documents — we can route DocuSign immediately.

Evidence list we typically collect for Private/On-prem evaluations
- SOC 2 Type II report (or Type I if that's what you have now)
- Dataflow diagrams showing PHI pathways (if HIPAA applies)
- Network topology / ingress-egress rules
- KMS integration notes and key custody model

Attachments we'll add to the Drive by EOD: redwood_security_playbook_v1.2.pdf, vendor_questionnaire_completed_example.xlsx

I'll hold the proposed slots for the tech deep-dive — Jordan, can you confirm the calendar invite once Anna picks a time?

Thanks,
